stories.title: Russian drone strike kills 14 at Dnipro railway station
stories.summary: A Russian jet‑powered drone hit a crowded platform at Dnipro’s main railway station, killing at least 14 people and wounding another 14, including an 11‑year‑old boy. The strike occurred while a passenger train bound for Zaporizhzhia was at the platform. Ukrainian officials said an elevated threat level had been announced before the attack; Russia’s military has not commented and Moscow denies deliberately targeting civilians.
stories.why: The attack shows how Ukraine’s rail network and civilian hubs remain vulnerable in the ongoing conflict.

stories.title: Indian trade minister says US deal will protect all sensitive Indian interests
stories.summary: Trade Minister Piyush Goyal stated that a pending trade agreement with the United States would safeguard all sensitive Indian interests. The comment was reported by The Economic Times. The article did not provide details on the deal’s specific terms, sectors covered, or concrete commitments.
